question: How many total medals did Haryana win in the fourth edition of Khelo India Youth Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**137.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• About Khelo India Programme:

 
 
• Khelo India was formed by merging three schemes: Rajiv Gandhi Khel Abhiyan, Urban Sports Infrastructure Scheme, and National Sports Talent Search Scheme.
 
• It works to promote "Sports for All" and "Sports for Excellence".
 
• Its aim is the mass participation of youth in annual sports competitions through a structured competition.
 
 
 
• **Khelo India Youth Games 2021:-**
 
 
• The 4th edition of the Khelo India Youth Games were held in Haryana.__
 
• The Games were be held in Panchkula.
 
• Gatka, Kalaripayattu, Thang-Ta, and Mallakhamba, four indigenous games were added in December 2020.
 
• This was announced by Sports Minister Kiren Rijiju and Haryana Chief Minister Manohar Lal Khattar.
 
• Usually, the Khelo India Youth Games take place in January every year. 
 
• Haryana came second in both Khelo India Youth Games 2019 and 2020 editions (200 medals in 2020 and 159 medals in 2019).
 
• The Haryana government decided to organize the Khelo India Youth Games in February 2022, in view of the possible third wave of the Covid-19 pandemic.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Fifth Edition of Khelo India Youth Games:-

 
 
• Khelo India Youth Games 2022 was organized in 8 cities of Madhya Pradesh from 31 January to 11 February 2023.
 
• These were organized in Madhya Pradesh's Bhopal, Balaghat, Mandla, Maheshwar, Jabalpur, Ujjain, Gwalior and Indore.
 
• There were a total of 28 sports in this game.
 
• This time, break dance and Malkhamb was also been included in the games.
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games were started on 31 January 2018 at the Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium in New Delhi.
